listing.name: NBA Live 97 — nbl-97-recomp (schulerj89)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Hybrid boot translation plus loaded-code interpreter; exhibition/tipoff/shooting/audio, other modes/hardware untested; launcher/netplay disabled. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-00267 NBA Live 97 CUE and tracks. The initial setup expects a single-track CloneCD layout; other layouts have not been confirmed. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Probe your own disc into a local game.toml using the project’s instructions. Run build.ps1 to generate the boot and OpenBIOS C code, then run.ps1 to start the native output. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This hybrid translates boot code and interprets loaded code. The project reports exhibition play, tipoff, shooting and audio; other modes and hardware remain untested. Launcher and netplay are disabled. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
